orion-cascades.label: Orion cascade comparison
orion-cascades.protocol: 8 threads, k=10. Median of three timed batches per L; existing graphs reused. The complete screen contains 168 cascades across seven datasets. Exact f32 is candidate reranking, not exhaustive search: at most min(2*k, beam size) candidates are rescored. PQ uses min(ceil(dimension/8),64) bytes/vector, 256 centroids/chunk, 4096 training rows and 12 iterations; these settings were not tuned.

baseline-panel.label: Baseline comparison
baseline-panel.protocol: One retained curve per engine and dataset. Historical measurements; thresholds select measured points without interpolation. MS-MARCO DiskANN is excluded for metric mismatch.

ada-baselines.label: Wiki-Ada baseline comparison
ada-baselines.protocol: 8 threads, k=10; normalized embeddings. Native ParlayANN recall includes boundary ties; Orion uses strict ID recall.

sift1b-engines.label: SIFT1B engine comparison
sift1b-engines.protocol: 8 threads, k=10. Three trials per setting, one index load per engine. Orion and ParlayANN share one job; DiskANN was measured separately. ParlayANN uses tie-aware recall.

ablation-ablation.label: Graph strategy ablation
ablation-ablation.protocol: Within-study comparison of full Orion, early stopping and extra edges. These historical curves are separate from the current default curve.

ablation-cascade_ablation.label: Cascade stage ablation
ablation-cascade_ablation.protocol: Within-study comparison of the full cascade and removed stages. These historical curves are separate from the current default curve.

build-profile.label: Build profile
build-profile.protocol: Mean of three historical construction trials at matched alpha. Orion graph construction and additional partitioning work are reported separately. This measures the earlier Rust/DiskANN construction path, not the current default ParlayANN builder.

memory-profile.label: Build allocation profile
memory-profile.protocol: Historical allocator-accounted peak and retained index bytes above the loaded base/query/ground-truth baseline. These are not whole-process RSS measurements.

thread-scaling.label: Thread scaling
thread-scaling.protocol: Median of five trials at a fixed search-list size. Engine recall is not matched in this study; scaling is normalized to each engine’s own one-thread throughput.

adaptive-early-stop.label: Adaptive switching × early stop
adaptive-early-stop.protocol: Same graph, cascade and calibration; 8 threads, k=10, median of five timed trials. NDC diagnostics cover every query and are outside timing. Bars compare the same L, not matched recall. NDC sums stage distance evaluations, which do not have equal computational cost. Default enables adaptive neighbors and early stop; Full neighbors disables both. Changes use Full neighbors at the same L as reference.
